Greater Melbourne's newest homemaker hub

Located amid the large-scale residential developments of Melbourne’s rapidly expanding north, Craigieburn Junction is a one-stop source of home styling inspiration and services to suit aspiring young families.

Acquired by QIC in September 2021 (two years after its completion), the centre hosts a range of large-format stores as well as commercial office suites, casual dining venues, childcare facilities and a medical clinic.

Major furniture outlets including Freedom, Nick Scali and Forty Winks are joined by leading Australian brands such as Supercheap Auto and Petbarn.

Centre snapshot

Ultimate convenience

With an easy-to-navigate layout and abundant carparking, Craigieburn Junction takes the hassle out of home furnishing.

Streamlined wellbeing

A specialist medical centre and multiple gyms make it easier for residents to stay healthy.

Eat, rest and repeat

Fast and convenient family dining options help visitors refuel in between browsing.

For the little ones

A 140-place early education centre provides much-needed childcare options for local families.
